Ray Dalio Spots AI Bubble Near Burst as SpaceX Hunts $40 Billion for Nvidia Chips

Ray Dalio warns AI forms a classic bubble nearing its burst amid surging debt and rates. SpaceX's $40B push for Nvidia chips after its IPO highlights the risks, as hyperscalers commit hundreds of billions. Earnings grow but cash conversion pressures mount. The cycle approaches a dangerous turn.
